items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was traveling in the South with Cab Calloway‟s band, Cozy Cole, and she was there with me around about that time.

ctx.x: You were traveling in the South then?

I was traveling in the South with Cab Calloway‟s band, Cozy Cole, and she was there with me around about that time. I was playing a solo and Benny [Unintelligible} the piano player said to me, he said, “I heard your father‟s in town, did you see him”? I said, “No”. He said, “Well there he is standing over there in the wings”. I saw this guy standing over there looking exactly like me [laugh]. I didn‟t know what to say to him. items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: we had a little thing they called them the Cab Jivers, we used to go down front, play, Tyree Glenn, Milt Hinton, me, and Chu.

ctx.x: Do you remember the night that Dizzy got fired?

Yeah, I was right there in the band. See, we had a little thing they called them the Cab Jivers, we used to go down front, play, Tyree Glenn, Milt Hinton, me, and Chu. And four of us in front of the bandstand. Well while we would be in front, see, the band in back of us would be blacked out and there would be just pin spots on us. Milt Hinton claims that he did it.
